notes_for_editor: Two short sources agree on the 1933 L-4 cab, 1940 abandonment, Nez Perce NF and the location 28 miles east of Kooskia at 6,807 ft. The brief's source list includes the Idaho Fire Lookouts St. Joe-Clearwater page (/st-joe-clearwater-region/round-top-lookout/). That page is a different site: Clearwater NF, elevation 6560 ft, 1934 40-foot pole L-4, destroyed 1972, with cement footings found. It matches us-id-round-top-mountain-2, so it is not used for this lookout's history; the story cites it only to tell readers the two apart. The record's source_pages list should drop it. The other name 'Round Top Mtn Lookout' is also used by that Clearwater site, so the name alone does not identify this lookout. Record coordinates (46.1288, -115.38187) were not checked against any source. Nothing says what remains at the site today; access level left unset.
